      Ilha Grande has no conventional road network for tourist journeys. Walking trails and sea routes connect its beaches, villages and coves, making the journey between places part of the experience itself.

Ilha Grande is reached by sea, including from Angra dos Reis. There is almost none of the usual car transport on the island: people walk or take boats between beaches and settlements.

Accommodation on the island centers on small pousadas, while life in the tourist villages is closely connected with the beaches, cafés and restaurants. Boat excursions, diving and coastal hiking routes offer more active experiences.

Ilha Grande can easily be combined with Angra dos Reis and Paraty on a single journey along the Costa Verde. The island is also part of the UNESCO World Heritage property “Paraty and Ilha Grande — Culture and Biodiversity,” inscribed in 2019.
